_bob.role: docs/GENERATION.md, the geometry family: pipeline steps 3 and 4, the A/B against Blender
_bob.purpose: Trellis2Simplify and Trellis2UVUnwrap as their own graph, so steps 3 and 4 can be measured against Blender Decimate / Quadriflow / Smart UV Project without touching the other stages.
_bob.derived_from: ComfyUI-TRELLIS2/workflows/refinement.json for the load-and-export skeleton, with Trellis2Simplify and Trellis2UVUnwrap in place of Trellis2RefineMesh
deviations_from_source: Trellis2RefineMesh, Trellis2EncodeMesh, Trellis2GetConditioning, LoadImage and LoadTrellis2Models are all dropped. Refinement needs the 4B model loaded; simplify and unwrap do not, so this graph runs with no model resident at all, which is what makes it a fair timing comparison against Blender.
mesh_audit.json was named as a second source in the plan and is NOT usable: it is built on PulseMeshAudit, from a pack that is not installed and is not a declared dependency of ComfyUI-TRELLIS2.
GeomPackLoadMesh replaced by Trellis2LoadMesh for the free-form path, same reason as mesh_texture.
Trellis2ExportTrimesh plus Preview3D for the retrievable output.

GeomPackNormalizeMeshToBBox(1.0) runs FIRST, for the reason mesh_process already carries it and measured on this graph the same way. Trellis2Simplify rescales nothing, so whatever space the mesh arrives in is the space mesh_texture is handed, and Trellis2EncodeMesh voxelises in the unit cube: a mesh outside it is a mesh the encoder cannot see and the albedo comes back BLACK with every other figure in the receipt healthy. It was a latent precondition while the only caller was TRELLIS.2 at [-0.5, 0.5], and the block-out route made it a defect -- Hunyuan3D-Omni returns [-1, 1], measured 1.99361 through mesh_geom_ctrl and still 1.99333 after this graph, and the asset shipped a 2048 square at spread 3.46 and mean 0.06. Isotropic and centred, so proportions survive and the footprint IoU the block-out route exists for is untouched.
_bob.requires_pack: ComfyUI-TRELLIS2 (PozzettiAndrea, MIT) plus ComfyUI-GeometryPack (GPL-3.0) for the normalise, which mesh_texture -- this graph's only consumer -- already needs
_bob.notes: No model load, so this is also the cheapest graph to smoke-test the mesh transport with. The output is unit-normalised, which is what mesh_texture's encoder requires and what nothing on the block-out route was providing.
